Recorded claim:
After an editor change, insertion of the Filelink root could leave three following BR elements. Entry317 removes exactly one only when that shape is present, then restores the original selection. Current guard remains. Existing tests check root outside signatures, spacing around written text and empty compose, and reply/forward with HTML/plaintext and signatures. This is an insertion-specific workaround, not a general rule to strip repeated BRs in user content. Relevant test sections were read but the full current2113-line matrix was not rerun.
